lines.en: You're in love with her?
I thought you knew that.
Um, no.
Oh.
Look, if it helps, I don't want to feel this way.
Honest.
I just keep thinking, "Ah, I'll get over this," you know?
But it just keeps getting harder, and I...
I don't... I don't know what to do.
You know? I don't...
What do I do?
You need to find out where she is.
Because if she's not where you are,
then you can start to move past this.
But what if, uh...
And I'm not saying she will be, but...
If she is where you are, then, uh...
Then my feeling weird about it shouldn't stand in the way.
Are you sure?
Yeah.
Look, if she's gonna end up with somebody else,
the truth is she couldn't find a better guy.
So...
Okay, thanks.
So when do you think you're gonna talk to her?
Oh, my God. I have to tell her.
I haven't even thought about what I would say.
Well, what should I say?
I'm understanding, but let's not get carried away.
Right away?
That's right.
